feeds.title: Fully Myelinated
feeds.description: I am a political science professor at NC State. My research and teaching interests are in American politics. I also love science, good television, and books about anything but politics. I decided that this blog could actually be a useful pedagogical tool. I'll be sharing my thoughts about all of the aforementioned topics, and whatever else happens to catch my interest, here.

feeds.title: Louisiana Voice
feeds.description: Tom Aswell, a native of Ruston, has lived in the Baton Rouge area for 30 years and for 10 of those years, ran Capitol News Service, covering state government for about 40 weekly and small daily newspapers throughout the state. Louisiana Voice blog was created to provide the citizens of Louisiana an inside look at how your legislators and other elected officials carry on the state's business and how your tax dollars are spent.

feeds.title: Saratoga Springs Politics
feeds.description: This blog is meant to dig deeper into the events and people who affect the city. There is simply a great deal that goes on that is never published. In addition, more and more people do not buy newspapers and depend on the web for their information.

feeds.title: Blue Delaware
feeds.description: Blue Delaware will be reporting on Delaware politics from a liberal, progressive and Democratic perspective. We will be advocating for a liberal and progressive Delaware and a liberal and progressive Delaware Democratic party. Our end goal is results - to critique in a manner where our voices are heard.

feeds.title: Political Observer on Populism
feeds.description: Political Observatory on Populism - publishes articles and interviews about populism. This blog is open to everyone, but it is also strictly against fascism, racism, and sexism. It investigates populism in all its forms as electoral strategy, ideology, style, political show, mediatized logic, outburst of social anger and frustration, blasts of coprolalia, social heuristic to make sense of the world, and more.

feeds.title: PoLAR
feeds.description: The journal of the Association for Political and Legal Anthropology, PoLAR: Political and Legal Anthropology Review is devoted to the anthropology of law and politics, most broadly conceived. It publishes work that is distinguished by its critical definition of problems, ethnographic orientation, or theoretical outlook.

feeds.title: Ginger Politics Blog
feeds.description: My name is Frazier Fathers, I am a double master's graduate with an M.A. from the University of Windsor and an M.P.P. from the University of Michigan. I am currently residing in Windsor Ontario. This blog has evolved from its original purpose of being a sounding board of my general ramblings on politics, a place to be accountable for my efforts to get in shape and to talk about travel to a blog about local policy issues impacting Windsor Ontario.

feeds.title: Singapore Politics Blog
feeds.description: 'Jess C Scott' is a pen name I've used since I was 12. I've always had a keen interest in anything analytical. Here, in this blog, I talk about the history and politics of Singapore.

feeds.title: Politics Teaching
feeds.description: I set up this website to support students of A-Level Politics by writing articles that aim to support their studies. In particular, by writing contemporary articles that link to the A-Level Specifications. We share resources that help teachers to plan and deliver the A-Level curriculum.

feeds.title: The Gateway Pundit
feeds.description: Covers breaking news, commentary, and analysis and provides opinion on the most pressing issues of the day. Founded in 2004, The Gateway Pundit espouses a politically conservative world view that supports conservative positions on most issues, including abortion, national defense, small government, second amendment rights, tax policy, individual freedom, and Constitutional values.

feeds.title: The Political Insider
feeds.description: They cover politics, culture, and opinion through expert analysis, thoughtful commentary, and in-depth investigations on issues facing Americans like you. The Political Insider publishes the authentic conservative voices of political insiders and award-winning contributors who believe in personal responsibility, limited government, free markets, individual liberty, traditional American values, and a strong national defense.

feeds.title: Taegan Goddard's Political Wire
feeds.description: Read interesting news, buzz, and commentary from inside the halls of government. Taegan Goddard is the founder of Political Wire, one of the earliest and most influential political websites. Taegan Goddard has spent more than a decade as managing director and chief operating officer of a prominent investment firm in New York City. Previously, he was a policy adviser to a U.S. Senator and Governor. Goddard earned degrees from Vassar College and Harvard University.

feeds.title: PoliticalBetting
feeds.description: Britain's most-read political blog and the best online resources for Betting on Politics. Read election analyst and gambler who's been running his award-winning blog since 2004.

feeds.title: National Review
feeds.description: National Review is a leading conservative magazine and website covering news, politics, current events, and culture with detailed analysis and commentary. Founded in 1955, as a magazine of conservative opinion, The magazine has defined the modern conservative movement and enjoys readership among American conservatives.

feeds.title: Twitchy » US Politics
feeds.description: Read the latest news, articles, and more about U.S. Politics. Twitchy is a ground-breaking social media curation site powered by a kinetic staff of social media junkies. We mine Twitter to bring you 'who said what' in U.S. & global news, sports, entertainment, media, and breaking news 24/7.

feeds.title: Mother Jones » Politics
feeds.description: Mother Jones, a prominent independent news organization, delivers groundbreaking coverage across politics, the environment, health, and human rights. Renowned for investigative journalism and innovative reporting, it offers insightful analysis and occasionally employs a sarcastic tone to engage readers.

feeds.title: Power Line
feeds.description: Powerlineblog.com is a hugely popular conservative blog run by a team of distinguished lawyers and academics - John H. Hinderaker, Scott W. Johnson, Paul Mirengoff and Steven Hayward. If you are looking for a passionate and incisive commentary on US politics, this is the place to be.

feeds.title: Guido Fawkes
feeds.description: Paul Staines, otherwise known as Guido Fawkes, certainly lives up to his pseudonym. His blog, which is described as a 'discussion on parliamentary plots, rumours & conspiracy' is nothing short of explosive. Not content with simply dissecting the murky goings-on in Westminster, Staines breaks the news that politicians don't want you to hear, & you get the impression he's enjoying every minute.

feeds.title: Crikey
feeds.description: Crikey is an Australian news and commentary website and newsletter, offering unique perspectives on politics. News and independent commentary on Australian federal, state and local government moves and politics in Crikey's unique style.

feeds.title: Conservative Home
feeds.description: Founded by Tim Montgomerie who has been described as 'one of the most influential Tories outside of the cabinet', Conservative Home was created as a hotspot for grassroots Conservative supporters. With a Tory Diary and a Majority section to explore how the Conservatives can win a majority at the next election, Conservative Home delivers all you need from the right end of the spectrum.

feeds.title: Politics.co.uk
feeds.description: Politics.co.uk is an impartial political website with no political affiliation, which prides itself on standing out as an independent voice in a landscape where the norm is to nail your colours to the mast. Up to the minute UK political news, features, view and analysis, plus guides, briefings and debate.

feeds.title: Colorado Pols
feeds.description: Colorado Pols is the most widely read and discussed political website in Colorado since it first went online in 2004. Here you will get all inside information and politics news.

feeds.title: Slugger O'Toole
feeds.description: Slugger O'Toole is an award winning news and opinion portal, which takes a critical look at various strands of political politics in Ireland and Britain. It tries to bring its readers 'open source analysis' from both the mainstream media and the blogosphere. And we are constantly on the look out for opportunities to add value to the debate of matters of regional, national and international concern.

feeds.title: PoliticusUSA
feeds.description: Bringing you news, political commentary & analysis from a liberal point of view. Founded by Sarah Jones and Jason Easley, PoliticusUSA is independent and is not affiliated with any political party or organization. It is a 100% independent digital publishing site offering liberal news, commentary, and opinion without fear or favor.

feeds.title: Schwartzreport
feeds.description: Schwartzreport is a daily publication in favor of the earth, the inter-connectedness, and interdependence of all life, democracy, liberty, and things that are life-affirming. It also warns readers about actions and events that threaten those values. Stories have been vetted for accuracy by either a significant peer-reviewed research journal or, at the least, a major journalistic publication.

feeds.title: Wings Over Scotland
feeds.description: We are the world's most-read Scottish politics website. Wings Over Scotland is a Scottish political website, which focuses particularly on the media, whether mainstream print and broadcast organisations or the online and social-network community, as well as offering its own commentary and analysis.

feeds.title: New Nationalism
feeds.description: This site seeks to create a new political movement dedicated to preserving American sovereignty and values and the American Dream for all citizens while respecting the sovereignty and goals of other nations. We believe the life and philosophy of former President Theodore Roosevelt offer a way to achieve this goal.

feeds.title: RealityChek
feeds.description: This is a blog to follow if you're sick and tired of the usually brain-dead left, right, and centrist conventional wisdom filling the media (mainstream and not) on economics, foreign policy, politics, and life in general. Alan Tonelson (that's me) is RealityChek's founder and voice. He has just finished more than 30 years of senior positions at leading US think tanks and publications to strike out on his own.

feeds.title: The American Conservative
feeds.description: The American Conservative was founded in 2002 to reignite the conversation that conservatives ought to have engaged in since the end of the Cold War, but didn't. We believe conservatism to be the most natural political tendency, rooted in man's taste for the familiar, for family, and for faith in God.

feeds.title: The Weekly Sift
feeds.description: The Weekly Sift is written by me, Doug Muder, a 60-something ex-mathematician who lives in Bedford, MA. Writing and journalism were my original ambition from back when I was editor of my high-school paper and had an after-school job at my hometown daily, the Quincy Herald-Whig. The Weekly Sift started as a way to get some momentum on Monday mornings. The idea was that I'd bookmark interesting links during the week, and then on Monday, I'd do a post about them. Those posts kept getting longer and longer until they finally turned into this blog.

feeds.title: Progress Pond
feeds.description: Progress Pond is a Washington Monthly. We are an online community for progressive-minded people who care about policy, elections, and global politics.

feeds.title: The Mahablog
feeds.description: The Mahablog talks about politics and society. We are making the world safe for Liberalism. The author is also a spiritual person who has published a book on life: The circle of the way.

feeds.title: Mock Paper Scissors
feeds.description: MOCK, PAPER, SCISSORS started off life as a crafty, DIY blog, but upon the re-election of CHIMPY MCSTAGGER turned distinctly political, where it remains to this day.

feeds.title: AJPS
feeds.description: The American Journal of Political Science is committed to significant advances in knowledge and understanding of citizenship, governance, and politics, and to the public value of political science research. AJPS is the official journal of the Midwest Political Science Association.

feeds.title: Angelo Lopez Blog
feeds.description: A website to promote the political cartoons of artist Angelo Lopez. Since December 2011, he has been the regular cartoonist for the PHILIPPINE NEWS TODAY, a Filipino American community newspaper based in the San Francisco Bay Area. In this blog, he talks about art, politics, and anything that interests him.

feeds.title: Unpolitically Correct » Politics
feeds.description: Find articles discussing politics. Unpolitically Correct is a place where we rise above our differences to discuss ideas and solutions to our nation's problems. We work through disagreements to arrive at actionable solutions.

feeds.title: rabble.ca
feeds.description: Rabble.ca was built on the efforts of progressive journalists, writers, artists and activists across the country and has a unique role of reporting on stories from civil society while providing a counter balance to corporate-owned media. It provides a needed space for issues, a place to explore political passions and an opportunity to expand ideas.

feeds.title: Alberta Politics
feeds.description: David J. Climenhaga is an award-winning journalist, author, post-secondary teacher, poet, and trade union, communicator. Alberta Politics is David Climenhaga's Polical Diary

feeds.title: EKOS Politics
feeds.description: EKOS Politics updating this site frequently with new polls, analysis and insight into Canadian politics. EKOS's experience, knowledge and sophisticated research designs have contributed positively to many previous elections.

feeds.title: Stephen Taylor
feeds.description: Stephen Taylor is a digital campaign pioneer in Canada. Taylor has been involved in national politics since 2004 and got his start organizing political bloggers in support of the nascent Conservative Party of Canada.

feeds.title: Steve Munro
feeds.description: The blog discusses the transit & politics of Toronto. I am Steve Munro, born in Toronto in September 1948. This site is not just me and my opinions, but the contributions of many to the discussions over the years.

feeds.title: James W.J. Bowden's Blog
feeds.description: A blog (primarily) on Canadian and Commonwealth political history and institutions. I started this blog in 2011, originally as a means of making the Manual of Official Procedure of the Government of Canada publicly available online. My area of academic expertise lies in Canadian political institutions, especially the Crown, political executive, and conventions of Responsible Government.

feeds.title: The Walrus » Politics
feeds.description: Our latest stories on Canadian politics, elections, parties, and policy, from the municipal to the federal level, plus the politics of the world around us and how they affect our democratic systems. The Walrus provokes new thinking and sparks conversation on matters vital to Canadians. As a registered charity, we publish independent, fact-based journalism, produce national, ideas-focused events, and train emerging professionals in publishing and nonprofit management.

feeds.title: Alberta Views » Politics
feeds.description: Welcome to the must-read magazine for the people who are shaping the new Alberta. Read Alberta Views publishes stories about politics, social issues, and the arts. Our stories are written by Alberta's best writers and thinkers.

feeds.title: Truthout » Politics & Elections
feeds.description: Truthout is a nonprofit news organization dedicated to providing independent reporting and commentary on a diverse range of social justice issues. Since our founding in 2001, we have anchored our work in principles of accuracy, transparency, and independence from the influence of corporate and political forces. It works to spark action by revealing systemic injustice and providing a platform for progressive and transformative ideas, through in-depth investigative reporting and critical analysis.

feeds.title: Political Behavior
feeds.description: This blog is designed to highlight work published in the journal Political Behavior. As editor of the journal, one of the things I am trying is asking authors to write short, accessible versions of their manuscripts for a broader audience. I will also occasionally post news about the journal here as well.

feeds.title: Rosedeer Blog
feeds.description: Relationship-builder, wordsmith, numbers guy, and strategist Mike brings these skills together for our clients to help them have a constructive two-way conversation with the public and key audiences. This is his personal blog where he writes mainly about politics - BC, Canada, and international. Views are my own, and my blog posts usually combine a historical perspective and data.

feeds.title: Irish Politics Forum
feeds.description: A Political Studies Association of Ireland (PSAI) blog for discussion of politics, policy and political reform. The purpose of the forum is to provide up-to-date analysis of contemporary political events and to encourage moderated comments on all issues relating to politics, policy, and political reform (broadly conceived).

feeds.title: Ken Rudin's Political Junkie Blog
feeds.description: Ken Rudin is one of America's foremost experts in politics and campaign history. He focuses on all aspects of politics, from presidential elections - with the primaries, national conventions, debates, and general election - to the races for the House, Senate, and state governors. He has analyzed every congressional race in the nation since 1984.

feeds.title: Eye on Global Politics Blog
feeds.description: Blog of Paul F.J Aranas, Lecturer in IR, Writer, and Author of Smokescreen, The US, NATO, and the Illegitimate Use of Force. Explore some of today's most pressing international issues with international relations.

feeds.title: A Brief History of Politics & Philosophy Blog
feeds.description: A history of political and philosophical ideas, but not for experts. It is a summary of western political ideas starting at the birth of politics with the ancient Greeks and ending at the present day. It is almost entirely based on Alan Ryan's book 'On Politics, A History of Political Thought from Herodotus to the Present', but is aimed at anyone just looking for an introductory summary.

feeds.title: Political Graffiti
feeds.description: I was born and raised in the Detroit area. I began my political cartooning career in college for the Eastern Echo. My first professional gig was at the Macomb Daily and then the Grosse Pointe News. My biggest influence was Draper Hill who was the Detroit News cartoonist from the 1970s thru the 90s.

feeds.title: The Oligarch Kings
feeds.description: I am David Macadam. I had an interest in the underdogs of life early on and started drawing political cartoons whilst still at school and have been giving people the benefit of my opinions ever since. I have drawn for national newspapers and traveled extensively in the States over many years.

feeds.title: Washington Monthly » Political Animal
feeds.description: Read articles that are dedicated to the politics of the country. The Washington Monthly was founded in 1969 on the notion that a handful of plucky young writers and editors, armed with an honest desire to make government work and a willingness to ask uncomfortable questions, could tell the story of what really matters in Washington better than a roomful of Beltway insiders at a Georgetown dinner party.

feeds.title: The White House
feeds.description: Get the latest news from The White House. The White House is where the President and First Family of the United States live and work - but it's also the People's House, where we hope all Americans feel a sense of inclusion and belonging.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Resistance
feeds.description: We cover commentary on policies that Democrats oppose, strategies and solutions suggested to constructively resist Trump and his authoritarianism, written by a psychotherapist with decades of experience. Baby Boomer Resistance Blog is staunchly Anti-Trump Administration.

feeds.title: The Right Scoop
feeds.description: The Right Scoop is a political and media blog interested in truth. Read the latest news, articles and more on the politics.

feeds.title: The Politics Guys
feeds.description: The Politics Guys are Michael Baranowski, Jay Carson, Trey Orndorff, Will Miller, Kristin Matheny, and Ken Katkin. The blog focus is American political institutions, public policy, and media.

feeds.title: Digby's Hullabaloo
feeds.description: Digby aka Heather Parton is an Old school blogger, columnist for Salon.com, and winner of the Hillman Prize for opinion journalism. Tom Sullivan, Dennis Hartley, Spocko, and Tristero contribute to this blog. The blog features articles on political news, events, updates, campaigns, political issues, politicians' life news, and more related subjects.

feeds.title: Routine Proceedings
feeds.description: My Question Period recaps, Q&As with MPs and Senators, and essays about issues of the day or my own particular musings will now be found here. I've been a member of the Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery since 2008, and I have a fairly obsessive knowledge about Canadian politics.

feeds.title: Steveso Thinks
feeds.description: A blog about liberal politics and progressive social issues. A retired American who lived in Penang, Malaysia, and now has returned to the US shares his thoughts, views and opinions on a variety of subjects ranging from the ridiculous to the controversial. The contents are only limited by his imagination.

feeds.title: National Newswatch
feeds.description: National Newswatch is Canada's most comprehensive site for political news and views. All day, every day, we help readers find and access must-see news and opinion articles and help authors and publishers find the readers and viewers who'll most appreciate their content.

feeds.title: Politics Today
feeds.description: Politics Today is a collection of daily news publications, covering Canada's Parliament and provincial legislatures. In Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia and on Parliament Hill we aim to be your top news source for in-depth politics, policy and expert analysis.
